FACT (tier-1, 사업보고서 제57기, 2026-03-10): LONG-RUN RECORD: cumulative profit cancellations of 1,860,828,928 common and 378,696,686 preferred shares at FY2025 year-end (1,934,188,242 common by 2026-06-30) - 24.9% of all common shares ever issued. vetoes.resolution_needed: Track the annual employee-compensation acquisition run-rate against actual cancellations. In H1 2026 acquisitions were KRW 13.25T while the cancellation carried KRW 5.35T at cost; on that trajectory the employee programme is consuming more stock than is being retired, even though headline share count fell. Flip to INVESTIGATE if that persists through FY2027.

evidence: FACT: Growth is price-and-mix driven within a genuine physical capacity shortage, not subsidy-, discount- or marketing-driven. Q2 2026 operating margin of 52.2% is the arithmetic proof that this is not bought revenue.
FACT: Demand is anchored to named customer platforms - HBM4 qualified at NVIDIA and AMD, position secured on the NVIDIA Rubin platform, Tesla AI5 in foundry.

FACT (tier-1, 사업보고서 제57기, 2026-03-10): GATE PARTIALLY ADVANCED - the normalisation baseline now exists. DS segment operating margin across a full cycle: -22.3% in FY2023 (a KRW 14.88T LOSS on KRW 66.59T revenue), 13.6% in FY2024, 19.1% in FY2025, 68.3% in H1 2026. That is the true amplitude of this business - roughly a KRW 158T swing in half-year-equivalent operating profit within three years.

FACT (tier-1, 사업보고서 제57기, 2026-03-10): ASP compounding: memory ASP +14% in FY2025 versus FY2024, then +220% in H1 2026 versus the FY2025 average - roughly 3.65x the FY2024 level reached in eighteen months.

FACT (tier-1, 반기보고서 2026-06-30): PARTIAL RESOLUTION IN SAMSUNG'S FAVOUR: Samsung is not leading the capex race. H1 2026 capex was KRW 31.23T, up only 16.4% YoY, while operating cash flow rose 328% to KRW 145.36T. The prior version of this assessment wrongly applied the industry's projected US$146B of 2027 capex to Samsung's own behaviour.

FACT (tier-1, 반기보고서 2026-06-30): BUT THE MECHANISM IS UNCHANGED, AND IS NOW QUANTIFIED: memory ASP rose approximately 220% in H1 2026 versus the FY2025 average, and DS operating margin went 13.6% (FY2024) to 19.1% (FY2025) to 68.3% (H1 2026). Industry supply sets the price Samsung receives, so Samsung's own restraint does not protect its margin. A 68.3% divisional operating margin is a rent, and rents are competed away.
FACT: Current incremental ROIC is at an unrepeatable peak - a 52.2% company-wide operating margin including the handset, display and Harman businesses.

ESTIMATE: Combined 2027 capex for Samsung, SK hynix and Micron is projected at US$146B (approx. KRW 209T), about 3.4x the US$43B of 2024. DRAM makers raised 2026 capex by an average of more than 40%, with meaningful shipment expansion arriving from H2 2027 onward.
FACT: Samsung's own absorption is enormous - KRW 110T+ of facility and R&D investment planned, Pyeongtaek P5 fab1 at KRW 60T+ with fab2 similar (2029 target), and a US$37B Taylor commitment.

INFERENCE: This is the exact mechanism by which memory incremental ROIC has collapsed in every prior cycle, and the capital is being committed now, at the peak. Sources genuinely disagree on the outcome - SK hynix's CEO publicly forecasts the industry's worst-ever shortage in 2027, while other analysis expects new-line startups to ease supply in 2028-2030.
vetoes.resolution_needed: STILL THE PRIMARY GATE, but materially advanced. A first-pass normalised model built on the FY2023-H1 2026 segment series gives group operating profit of roughly KRW 93-132T, BELOW the KRW 145-183T the price requires. What remains is to test that range against the announced 2027-2029 industry capacity additions and against HBM contract structure. Note the model's own limits: mid-cycle DS revenue of KRW 250-300T and a 30-38% margin are ESTIMATES, already assumed well above any prior mid-cycle level. If HBM mix pushes normalised DS margin above 40% on KRW 320T of revenue the requirement is met - so the gate is not closed against the company, it is closed against the current price.

evidence: FACT: Direction of change is positive, which is what this veto tests. HBM share rose 21% (Q1 2026) to 33% (Q2 2026) while SK hynix fell from 64% a year earlier to 50%.

FACT: Samsung passed HBM4 qualification at NVIDIA and AMD first and began shipping in Q2 2026, securing a Rubin platform position; SK hynix's HBM4 mass production slipped to Q3 2026 on interface sync issues with full-year shipments revised down.
FACT: Foundry utilisation exceeded 80% in Q1 2026, the highest in about a year, with the Tesla AI5 win and breakeven pulled forward from 2027 to 2026.

COUNTER: Sources conflict on the exact Q2 2026 share level (Counterpoint SK 50% / Samsung 33%; another report Samsung 38% / SK 25%, which appears to conflate a year-end target with an actual). Direction is consistent across sources; level is not.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Re-test at Q3 and Q4 2026. If Samsung's share gain proves to be a temporary allocation shift during a competitor's stumble rather than a durable technology lead, this flips to INVESTIGATE.

evidence: INFERENCE: At the 2026-09-03 close of KRW 250,000 the price does NOT require the current peak to persist - roughly 7x annualised H1 2026 earnings already discounts a large normalisation. On that test the veto does not trigger.

COUNTER-INFERENCE: But at a 12-15x normalised multiple the price requires mid-cycle operating profit of roughly KRW 145-180T, or 2.5-3.1x the previous all-time peak of KRW 58.9T (2018), sustained. Equivalently it requires about 50-60% of the current run-rate to become the new normal.

FACT (tier-1, 반기보고서 2026-06-30): SECOND CORRECTION, same direction as the first: with controlling-interest equity measured at KRW 565.06T, P/B is approximately 2.89x on current book (BPS approximately KRW 86,051 ex-treasury) and roughly 2.5x on estimated year-end book - not the 2.29x previously stated. Offsetting this, net cash of KRW 167.54T lowers EV to approximately KRW 1,466T, and the EV/EBIT method independently reproduces the same required normalised operating profit range of KRW 147-183T.
ESTIMATE: Forward P/B of approximately 2.3x (2026E BPS KRW 109,313) sits at or above the top of Samsung's historical 0.9x-2.1x range, on peak-inflated book.
CORRECTION: The screening run of 2026-09-04 cited a stale broker figure of approximately 1.4x forward P/B. That figure appears to reference 2025 and is superseded.

STATUS RECONSIDERED, HELD AT INVESTIGATE: the normalised model now lands BELOW the price requirement (KRW 93-132T versus KRW 145-183T), which is a meaningful deterioration in the expectation gap and is why expectation_gap_and_valuation falls 6/15 to 5/15. The veto is nonetheless NOT triggered: at roughly 7.0x annualised H1 EPS the price does not require bull-case-or-better execution, and reaching KRW 145T of group operating profit needs roughly 60% of the current condition to persist - demanding, but not heroic. The distinction matters: this is an unattractive price, not an impossible one.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Still not an unrealistic-bull-case trigger - roughly 7.0x annualised H1 EPS of KRW 35,804 is not a demanding multiple. It remains a thin margin. The remaining unverified input is the preferred-share price; consolidated net cash is now resolved.

evidence: FACT (tier-1, 반기보고서 2026-06-30): CONCENTRATION NOW MEASURED, NOT INFERRED: DS generated KRW 142.86T of the group's KRW 146.73T H1 operating profit - 97.4%. DX contributed KRW 2.15T (1.5%), SDC KRW 1.04T (0.7%) and Harman KRW 0.64T (0.4%). DS operating margin was 68.3%.

INFERENCE: Profit concentration is extreme. With company-wide operating margin at 52.2%, essentially all incremental profit is semiconductor, within semiconductor it is memory, and within memory the swing factor is HBM4 allocation at a small number of accelerator customers. MX, VD and Harman are no longer profit-material at the margin.

INFERENCE: The end-demand funding source is concentrated too - hyperscaler capex guided above $725B for 2026 is now exceeding those customers' operating cash flow, with Alphabet reporting its first negative-FCF quarter since 2004 and Meta's cash generation down 91% YoY.
FACT: Manufacturing footprint includes Chinese fabs subject to US export-control policy, and the Taylor, Texas build-out is a US$37B single-site commitment.

FACT (tier-1, 반기보고서 2026-06-30): MITIGANT, also newly measured: DX operating margin fell from 6.8% in FY2025 to 2.1% in H1 2026 because Samsung's own set business absorbs the memory rent. That is a genuine internal counter-cyclical hedge which SK hynix and Micron lack - on normalisation DX profit recovers as DS falls.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Quantify HBM revenue by customer within DS, and size the DX recovery that would offset a DS normalisation. The concentration is severe but demonstrably not fatal - the group retains KRW 167.54T of net cash and a downstream business that benefits from the reverse of the current condition.
